reporting-org.narrative: United Nations Office for Project Services

description.narrative:
Based on three decades of partnership with the Government of Ukraine, UNDP has been working with municipalities, civil society organizations, and business associations across the country. 

UNOPS supports UNDP in Ukraine through rapid response capacity for the scaling up of Humanitarian Mine Action capacities of state actors. In particular, UNOPS will provide support to the UNDP office in Ukraine through procurement and contracting of operational resources.
